boundary: Official and primary sources supply vocabulary, constraints, abstentions, and source status only. They provide no real accession, seed, packet, lot, storage chamber, sensor row, viability or germination result, person, traditional knowledge, rights, transfer, benefit-sharing, professional, legal, cultural, Māori-authority, production, empirical, or Stage 20 evidence.

sources.phase_use: Objects, events, agents, rights, preservation metadata, and version vocabulary.
sources.title: PREMIS Data Dictionary and Schema 3.0

sources.phase_use: Accession, seed storage, viability monitoring, documentation, distribution, safety duplication, and security vocabulary only; no real genebank procedure is executed.
sources.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
sources.title: Genebank Standards for Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture

sources.phase_use: Conservation, access, benefit-sharing, Farmers' Rights, and competent-authority reservation vocabulary only; no legal classification or transfer decision.
sources.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
sources.title: Text of the International Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture

sources.phase_use: Prior informed consent, mutually agreed terms, Indigenous and local community involvement, competent authority, and confidentiality vocabulary; citation is not legal advice or authorization.
sources.title: Text of the Nagoya Protocol on Access and Benefit-sharing

sources.phase_use: Accession identity, passport-data, taxonomy, institute, and API-version vocabulary; this phase makes zero calls, uses no credential, and reads zero accession rows.
sources.title: Genesys API reference manual

sources.phase_use: Occurrence and taxonomic-reference vocabulary for a zero-call adapter only; no query, download, occurrence, or taxonomic conclusion.
sources.title: GBIF Occurrence API technical documentation

sources.phase_use: Entity, activity, agent, derivation, revision, invalidation, and qualified-provenance vocabulary.
sources.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology

sources.phase_use: Structural accessibility targets and an explicit reminder that conformance cannot address every user need.
sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2

sources.phase_use: Issuer, holder, verifier, claims, proof, status, privacy, accessibility, and security vocabulary; no production credential.
sources.title: Verifiable Credentials Data Model v2.0

sources.phase_use: Watch-only change surface; it supplies no normative requirement to this phase.
sources.title: Verifiable Credentials Data Model editor draft

sources.phase_use: Purpose, indirect collection notification including IPP 3A, security, access, correction, accuracy, retention, use, disclosure, and identifier constraints.
sources.publisher: Office of the Privacy Commissioner, New Zealand
sources.title: Privacy Act 2020 privacy principles

sources.phase_use: Authority-held rights and interests in data; citation does not transfer Māori authority or cultural legitimacy.
sources.title: Principles of Māori Data Sovereignty

sources.phase_use: Informational deterministic JSON serialization vocabulary; not a digital signature or trust anchor.
sources.title: RFC 8785: JSON Canonicalization Scheme

sources.phase_use: Units and quantity-writing vocabulary only; the official page warns SP 811 is not updated for the 2019 SI revision.
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.title: NIST Special Publication 811 page

sources.phase_use: Uncertainty vocabulary and reference links only; no measurement result or calibration evidence.
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.title: Uncertainty of Measurement Results
